column14: Canonical 400V NMC tapered curve. Brief peak, continuous decline.
LFP chemistry: lower peak, slower taper, charged to 100% routinely.
800V E-GMP platform. Wide flat plateau then sharp step at ~50%.
Distinct staircase: hold at 225kW, step to 160kW, step to 110kW.
Large pack, lower peak due to thermal limits. Long total charge time.
900V architecture, ultra-fast peak. Sustained high power well into mid-SOC.

Curve shape normalised from TNO R11236 Living Lab Heavy Duty Laadpleinen (2025), Fig 4.11, 400kW charger subgraph. Sessions from multiple current-gen HD trucks. Not attributed to any specific manufacturer.
Charge curve from Fastned brands overview, measured at 150+ kW charger.
